be entitled to a refund: If the jacket arrives damaged, you are entitled to a refund as long as you return it within thirty days.
如果夾克送達時已損壞，只要在三十天內退回，你就有權退款。
be entitled to vote: In many countries, people are entitled to vote once they turn eighteen and can help choose their leaders.
在許多國家，人們一滿十八歲就有投票權，可以幫忙選出他們的領導人。
a book entitled: My grandfather wrote a book entitled Stories from the Farm about his childhood in the countryside.
我祖父寫了一本名為《農場故事》的書，內容是關於他在鄉下的童年。
entitle someone to: This membership card will entitle someone to a ten percent discount at any of our stores.
這張會員卡讓持有者有權在我們任何一家店享有九折優惠。
equip students with skills: Good teachers try to equip students with skills they can still use long after they leave school.
好老師會努力讓學生具備在離開學校很久之後仍用得上的技能。
be equipped with: The new classrooms are equipped with smart boards, so teachers can easily show videos during lessons.
新教室配備了智慧黑板，所以老師上課時可以輕鬆播放影片。
be well equipped to handle: With new tools and years of training, the rescue team is well equipped to handle emergencies in the mountains.
有了新工具和多年訓練，救難隊已具備充分能力處理山區的緊急狀況。
erase memories: She wished she could erase memories of the terrible accident, but they kept coming back at night.
她希望能抹去那場可怕意外的記憶，但這些記憶在夜裡一再浮現。
erase a debt: The kind businessman offered to erase a debt that the poor family had owed him for years.
那位好心的商人提議免除這個貧窮家庭欠他多年的債務。
erase the past: You cannot erase the past, but you can learn from your mistakes and build a better future.
你無法抹去過去，但你可以從錯誤中學習，打造更好的未來。
erase data: Before you sell your old phone, remember to completely erase data such as photos so the new owner cannot see them.
賣掉舊手機之前，記得徹底清除照片等資料，這樣新主人才看不到。
erect a statue: The city will erect a statue in the square that will stand ten meters tall when workers finish it.
市政府將在廣場上豎立一座雕像，工人完工後它將高達十公尺。
erect barriers: The government decided to erect barriers to foreign trade by raising taxes on imported cars.
政府決定透過提高進口車的稅來對外國貿易設置障礙。
erect a tent: We arrived at the campsite late, so we had to erect a tent in the dark using our flashlights.
我們很晚才抵達營地，所以只好用手電筒在黑暗中搭帳篷。
violence erupted: Violence erupted in the streets after the election results were announced, and many shops were damaged.
選舉結果公布後，街頭爆發暴力衝突，許多商店遭到破壞。
erupt in applause: As soon as the singer finished her final song, the audience began to erupt in applause and cheers.
歌手一唱完最後一首歌，觀眾就爆出熱烈的掌聲和歡呼。
a volcano erupts: When a volcano erupts, hot rock and ash can cover nearby towns and force people to leave their homes.
火山爆發時，熾熱的岩石和火山灰會覆蓋附近的城鎮，迫使人們離開家園。
erupt in anger: My usually calm father would erupt in anger whenever he found out someone had lied to him.
我平常冷靜的父親每當發現有人對他說謊，就會勃然大怒。
escape notice: The small mistake in the report managed to escape notice until the manager read it a second time.
報告中的小錯誤一直沒被注意到，直到經理第二次讀它。
the name escapes me: I know I met that woman at the party last week, but the name escapes me right now.
我知道上週在派對上見過那位女士，但我一時想不起她的名字。
escape punishment: The thief thought he could escape punishment, but the police caught him two days later.
小偷以為自己可以逃過懲罰，但警方兩天後就抓到了他。
escape death: The climbers were lucky to escape death when a huge storm suddenly hit the mountain.
一場大暴風雨突然襲擊那座山時，登山客們很幸運地逃過一死。
escape reality: Some teenagers play video games for hours to escape reality and forget about their problems at school.
有些青少年會連續打好幾個小時的電玩來逃避現實，忘掉在學校的問題。
establish a company: After graduating from college, my cousin decided to establish a company that sells healthy snacks online.
我表哥大學畢業後，決定成立一家在網路上販售健康零食的公司。
establish a relationship: It takes time to establish a relationship of trust with new classmates, so try to be patient.
和新同學建立信任的關係需要時間，所以試著要有耐心。
establish the facts: Before the judge makes a final decision, the court must first establish the facts of the case.
在法官做出最後判決之前，法院必須先查明案件的事實。
establish a reputation: The young chef worked hard for years to establish a reputation as the best cook in town.
這位年輕主廚努力多年，才建立起鎮上最佳廚師的名聲。
establish contact: After two days of searching, the rescue team finally managed to establish contact with the lost hikers by radio.
經過兩天搜尋，救難隊終於用無線電和迷路的登山客取得聯繫。
establish a rule: Since our new club had no rules at all, the founders needed to establish a rule about choosing leaders.
